title: Brighton Fringe removes Ben Carter as venue manager and takes control of Half a Camel operations
summary: Brighton Fringe informed Ben Carter that due to concerns raised by performers following his email titled 'Duncan', he was removed from venue management roles and all communication responsibilities were transferred to the Fringe. Artists were told Ben was no longer the point of contact, and the Fringe would manage all operations going forward.
quoted_content: we have received emails, and phone calls from your programmed artists who are very concerned
we have taken the decision to relieve you of your Venue Manager position
we are currently calling all Half a Camel Venues
we have emailed your artists the following email
Currently, as we can see from our side, your show has not been cancelled on Eventotron
We hope you understand our decision to support you and Fringe artists in this way
